follow_up_experiments.excluded: Wave64 two-query candidate spilled 108 bytes/lane and was not timed. Fourfold unrolling failed allocation/scheduling. The scale-FMA screening has not received the full production stress suite or long-sequence validation.

notes: No attention trial reached 45. V tiling is lossless; reference values are unchanged.
CU mode is an ELF descriptor diagnostic, not a production Loom feature. Its only patch clears WGP_MODE.
The compressed 128-key and tied-multiply probes used temporary compiler changes; both were restored.
The first multied screening accidentally retained the original rescale operation and is excluded; multied-real and multiednocopy contain the intended operations.
Grouped tied rescaling and scalar loop-state variants compiled to 256 and 248 VGPRs respectively and were not timed.
Matrix-only calibration uses constant nonzero operands reused in registers and exactly checked outputs. It excludes all attention work and is not a substitute for attention throughput.
All three matrix calibration binaries and the production attention binary were reproduced byte-for-byte with the restored compiler.

odd_wave_follow_up.note: Queued behind an external render with --wait-idle. All sampled outputs match production exactly; no candidate improved throughput. Clock monitor returned no readings. Not a sustained performance claim.

memory_clause_follow_up.clause_instruction: s_clause 30 (31 VMEM instructions), final load outside clause

resources.note: Separate 64-bit LDS accesses; theoretical workgroup residency is a hypothesis, not measured occupancy.

independent_operand_matrix_calibration.scope: Matrix-only, no attention; not evidence the 45 attention goal was achieved. FP16 varied case uses positive inputs with limited mantissas.

validated_positive_fp16_report.note: Matrix-only calibration, not attention throughput. Same binary for both datasets. Half INT8 and half FP16 matrix operations; operands are loaded once, then reused. Varied operands alternate A0/A1 with A0+A1=1 in integer code units; B differs and has bounded row sums. Varied FP16 A0 is binary, A1 is its complement, B is positive codes 1..7; FP16 codes are divided by 8. This avoids the failed signed-cancellation calibration and does not test arbitrary FP16 mantissas or signs.

rejected_signed_cancellation_diagnostic.status: rejected: varied FP16 outputs did not match exact arithmetic reference
rejected_signed_cancellation_diagnostic.interpretation: The proposed exactness assumption failed, including at one loop iteration (8 WMMA updates per accumulator). Cause is unresolved; this does not establish a hardware or compiler defect. No failed timing is counted as a validated attention or varied-data matrix throughput result.

centered_fp16_logit_follow_up.precision_change: Per-lane eight-score chunks are centered against their FP32 maximum, temporarily stored in FP16, then promoted before FP32 exp2, with a FP32 chunk-to-global maximum offset. Production precision was unchanged.

polynomial_exp2_follow_up.method: For x<=0: clamp x to -126, n=trunc(x), r=x-n, approximate 2^x as 2^n * (1+r*(a+r*(b+r*c))). Only weight exponentials changed; old-output rescaling retains native exp2. Mixed variant substitutes two of four eight-score blocks.

zero_accumulator_confirmation.conclusion: Long alternating comparisons did not reproduce the initial screening gain. Production unchanged.

phase_profiling_attempt.status: Incomplete: repeated concurrent GPU jobs prevented clean large-shape comparison; waiting driver stopped.

small_gate.timing_discarded: Concurrent GPU jobs; correctness gate only.

caveats: Shader clock reads mark instruction issue boundaries, not fully serialized VALU completion.
Cycles are same-wave deltas from a 20-bit counter, summed across waves.
Stage fractions are not additive GPU wall times; init, loop accounting, and final stores lie outside the marked regions.
Instrumentation overhead has not yet been measured at large shapes.

allocator_fix_report.fix: Grow mandatory tied-concat alias reservations beyond the optional 16-entry working set; size storage lease aliases before copying.
allocator_fix_report.clock_descriptor: Separate experimental patch; side-effecting shader cycle read used only for phase profiling.
